knowledge_gaps: Training-prefix targets may already have been used to fit the frozen model. Their ranks measure training fit, not generalization; user bootstrap intervals do not remove this bias.
Deletion and repacking change retained items’ convolutional positions and receptive-field coverage. Matching deletion counts and item frequencies alone cannot isolate recency effects.

Reproducibility requires explicit prefix sampling, intervention windows, matching tolerances, candidate exclusions, tie handling, bootstrap settings, and computation limits. Full-catalog scoring across four datasets may make the code-difficulty rating optimistic.
The proposal supports a diagnostic experiment, but its future-potential rating remains speculative until probe findings predict improvements on the unchanged host validation metric.
